acc.hintPlan: Today's Plan counts this as about {h}.
acc.how: Studyboard also learns your pace. Once you have finished a few tasks it allows for how long your estimates really turn out to take (by kind of task, and by course when there is enough history), gently matches how much it plans each day to what you actually get done, and starts tasks a little sooner if you usually finish close to the deadline. Nothing changes until there are several tasks to learn from, and you can turn this off in Settings.
acc.howOff: Learning from your own pace is turned off in Settings, so the plan uses your estimates exactly as you typed them.
acc.logAria: Add time you spent on this task
acc.offToast: Plans will use your estimates as typed
acc.onToast: Plans will allow for your own pace

acc.peakHard: Hard, and this is when you usually do your best work
acc.setOff: Off. Plans use your estimates exactly as typed.
acc.setOn: On. It starts once you have finished a few tasks with a time estimate.
acc.setSub: Adjust plans to how long your work really takes, using time you track and how you finish tasks. Stays on this device and in your own tasks.
acc.startSooner: You often finish close to the deadline, so starting a little early helps
acc.under: You usually finish {what} in about {x}x your estimate.
acc.underWhy: These usually take you longer than you estimate
